structured.answer: I'll ask you, and maybe the bank, about government bonds (איגרות חוב ממשלתיות) and that מק"מ from בנק ישראל, because they're loans to the state, which pays back. I'm not moving any money, though: the page never says how much they earn compared to my deposit, or what the bank takes from me.

stuck.where: Section 'כסף שוטף וקצר' between screen 1 and screen 2
stuck.why: The screen cut off right where the boxes start, and on the next screen I saw only their last lines ('הבנק משלם עליו ריבית', 'לתקופה מוסכמת בריבית'), never their titles. That's probably the deposits part, the one that was about me.
It talks right away about מק"מ, קרן כספית and מדד מניות. I almost thought it wasn't for me.

stuck.where: Screens 3-4, the מדד cards with English letters
stuck.why: Full of MSCI, S&P, נאסד"ק. I got tired and anxious and stopped reading.

findings.where: Whole page, especially the small lines under headings

findings.what: Unknown, personal, non-official site. I wouldn't act on it without the bank or my son.
